text: {"name":"gpio_configure_pin","confidence":"high","docstring":"Configures a GPIO pin's control bits, writes the supplied value to its per-pin register, and initializes shared GPIO state if its ready flag is clear.","subsystem":"gpio","var_renames":{"result":"pin_index","a2":"pin_mode","a3":"pin_config_value","v3":"pin_mask","v6":"pin_mask_clear","v9":"controller_initialized"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Pin-mode control bit; set when pin_mode is 2 and cleared otherwise."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Secondary pin-mode control bit; set when pin_mode is 0 and cleared for other non-2 modes."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Register assigned the one-hot mask for the selected pin."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Grouped configuration fields ORed with 7 shifted by the pin index rounded down to a multiple of four."}]}
